skull-a#0.notes: fills the canvas, big dark eyes and teeth read at 16 and 32 on light and dark tabs; dark outline holds on #f2f2f2; 16 px hand-finished by recorded edits

key-a#0.notes: nice chunky key but wider than tall: at 16 px it shrinks to a thin diagonal and the ring hole closes; the skull reads better

key-b#0.notes: thin diagonal key with a white halo outline around the dark one; too thin for 16 px
